notes: Library Commission minutes 1954-57, 1959-66 and 1973-74 (SFPL volumes minutesofregular1619sanf, 1219sanf, 1196sanf, minutesofregula1119sanf_0/_1, 1619sanf_0). Curated: the Appleton & Wolfard branch programme (Marina, Ortega, Merced, North Beach, Eureka Valley, Western Addition, Excelsior), the Waden bequest for Bayview, Visitacion Valley's move. Dated by the 'held <date>' line of each meeting; meetings whose heading did not OCR were dated by hand.

coverage.remaining: Held: four Eureka Valley Branch Library findings (architects 1959, drawings 1960, Leon Carlen's contract 1960, opening 20 Dec 1961 and dedication 22 Jan 1962): the branch, now 1 Jose Sarria Court, formerly 3555 16th Street, has no EAS address, so no page; whoever seeds it takes them up. Not placed: the Glen Park branch at 700 Bosworth Street (opened January 3, 1927, per the 1919-45 volume) and at 2909 Diamond Street (1964), both gone for the Bosworth widening and Glen Park BART; the 1954 Outer/West Sunset branch plans (not certain they are Ortega); Diamond Heights requests. 1919-45 volume (minutesofregular1119sanf) has poor OCR and few building items.
